## Selected research and projects

::: {.cv-projects}
- **Few-Step Field Regularity:** exact Gaussian analysis of probability paths,
  field regularity, and finite-step numerical error. Sole author; accepted as a
  poster at the NeurIPS 2026 GDDL workshop (non-archival).
- **Ego-World JEPA:** action-conditioned latent world models and MPPI planning
  on PushT, with a documented negative result.
- **Adaptive Latent Search:** learned and heuristic stopping rules for
  compute allocation during latent optimization.
- **Decision Transformer for LOB trading:** five-seed offline-RL benchmark on
  FI-2010, co-developed with Côme Genet.
- **Proximal Diffusion Models:** PyTorch reproduction of published proximal
  diffusion methods.
:::

See [Research](research.qmd) for questions, results, limitations, and public artifacts.
